info.name: National University of Colombia - Institutional Repository OAI-PMH REST - Core API

description.content:
Machine-readable description of the publicly accessible, read-only surface of the Repositorio Institucional Universidad Nacional de Colombia, powered by DSpace 7.6.5. Two interfaces are documented: the DSpace REST API (HAL+JSON) and the OAI-PMH 2.0 metadata harvesting interface. Only endpoints confirmed to resolve anonymously during discovery are included. Endpoints that require authentication (e.g. /server/api/core/items) are intentionally omitted.
